releaseNotes: Fixed a horizontal scrollbar duplication bug under the Commit Graph — a stray CSS overflow rule made the commit list a second scroll owner alongside the graph panel, so only one scrollbar shows now.

GitToto Recovery: Pull/Push/Merge and other write operations are now scoped per repository instead of app-wide — you can run a Pull on one repository while a Push runs on another, including across linked worktrees. Closing a tab is still blocked only while that specific repository has an operation running.
Fixed Pull incorrectly showing a "diverged history" dialog when local had commits simply ahead of the remote (nothing to actually merge).
Fixed a rare Pull-with-Auto-Stash race where a real stash re-apply conflict could be reported as a clean success.
Fixed switching repository tabs silently starting a new terminal shell for a repository you never opened a terminal in.
Terminal: resizing is now debounced for smoother drag performance, and Scrollback is now configurable in Settings → Terminal.
